  ## 2. Mission and values Our mission is to give every utility a clear, current picture of its grid. We hold four values. Measure first. We make decisions from data, and we say so when we do not have the data. Own the outcome. The person who starts a piece of work follows it until a customer can use it. Be direct and kind. We give feedback early, in plain words, and with respect.

  [5. Writing readings] 5.3 A client should send an `Idempotency-Key` header with a unique value for each batch. If a request with the same key arrives again, the API returns the original response and does not store the readings a second time. Idempotency keys are remembered for 24 hours. 5.4 A reading for a meter and timestamp that already exists replaces the stored reading. The replaced value is kept in the audit history for 90 days.
